## Changes involved
- Added JSDocs to each parameter when initializing `useSupabaseUpload` hook
- Added `allowedMimeTypes` to be returned from `useSupabaseUpload` hook
- Added `cacheControl` and `upsert` to be optional params for `useSupabaseUpload` hook
- Updated `maxFiles` param from `useSupabaseHook` to be default 1 instead of 0
- Fixed `maxFileSize` message to be formatted based on bytes (not fixed at MB)
- Added client side validation for `maxFiles`
- Add UI truncate for long file names
- Allow `path` prop to be optional (Support uploading to root of bucket)
- Prevent removal of files on the UI while uploading
- Handle partial upload success (some files uploaded, some files didn't)
  - Updated error/success handling to be on a per file level
  - There's also a `isSuccess` state if all uploads end up successful
- Handle `onDrop` for preventing duplicate file names

## To test (and also tested on my end locally)
- [x] Success state when all files are uploaded successfully
- [x] Client side validations for max file size and max files
- [ ] Partial success state when uploading files but some files errored-out (e.g same name + upsert set to false)

  - When hitting "Upload" while in a partial state, only files that errored-out, or new files that are added will be uploaded (Uploading is skipped for files that have already been successfully uploaded)

# Key Updates:
### Icon and Navigation Adjustments:
* Changed the icon in `FoodDetailPage` from `CupertinoIcons.cart_fill` to `Icons.restaurant` to better represent the food detail context.
* Updated the navigation in `FoodInputPage` to use a named route (`'/food-text-input'`) instead of pushing a new `FoodTextInputPage` directly.

### User Interface & User Experience Enhancements:
* Added a description based on the message in `FoodAnalysisLoading` to provide clearer feedback to the user. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-e70e06a0875c8dfd589ef9ce5e11c21fb2f33bce1f635fe08575d5495a038ae9L9-R27) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-e70e06a0875c8dfd589ef9ce5e11c21fb2f33bce1f635fe08575d5495a038ae9L54-R63)
* Translated comments to English in `FoodAnalysisLoading` for better readability.

### State & Data Handling Improvements:
* Added `isSaving` state in `NutritionPage` to manage the saving process and updated the UI accordingly. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-7fc7d56481dfcc12f1bc45733ee84f514444b529f5b7311e235c18a766e338a2R27) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-7fc7d56481dfcc12f1bc45733ee84f514444b529f5b7311e235c18a766e338a2L107-L120)
* Modified the `saveFoodAnalysis` method in `FoodTextInputService` to include an `isCorrected` parameter for better data handling.

[[1]](diffhunk://#diff-7fc7d56481dfcc12f1bc45733ee84f514444b529f5b7311e235c18a766e338a2L63-R64) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-7fc7d56481dfcc12f1bc45733ee84f514444b529f5b7311e235c18a766e338a2R78-R81)

### Route Management:

[[1]](diffhunk://#diff-e61eb31d013d12616f5532636a88cfa63631dda8f7829e5424e68542214d1608R32) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-e61eb31d013d12616f5532636a88cfa63631dda8f7829e5424e68542214d1608R200)

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## **New Updates from Today**  

### **Navigation Fix for "Edit Input" Button**
* Fixed an issue where pressing **"Edit Input"** on the `FoodTextInputAnalysisError` screen would return to the loading analysis page instead of the actual **food input page**.
* Now, the button correctly **pops twice** to ensure the user lands on the input screen. [[[1]](diffhunk://#diff-7fc7d56481dfcc12f1bc45733ee84f514444b529f5b7311e235c18a766e338a2L58-R61)](diffhunk://#diff-7fc7d56481dfcc12f1bc45733ee84f514444b529f5b7311e235c18a766e338a2L58-R61)

body:
### Description
<!-- Describe your changes. -->
For GroupQueryAttention op, if the input total_sequence_length is a constant, we can infer the shape of output present_key/present_value `(batch_size, kv_num_heads, present_sequence_length, head_size)`.

https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/blob/5ed900e9712ce2f02e40c15b945d18453d1960d8/onnxruntime/contrib_ops/cpu/bert/group_query_attention_helper.h#L185

We know that from CPU EP, `present_sequence_length = max(past_sequence_length, total_sequence_length)`, and `batch_size, kv_num_heads, head_size` are the same as past_key/past_value.

This inference is very important for WebNN EP, because WebNN only supports GQA for `present_sequence_length == past_sequence_length` and requires static shape for graph compilation.

body:
## What is the purpose of the change

This PR aims to replace `Timer` with single thread scheduled executor for `BlobServer`.
The javadoc recommends `ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor` instead of `Timer`.
![屏幕快照 2024-01-12 下午12 47 57](https://github.com/apache/spark/assets/8486025/4fc5ed61-6bb9-4768-915a-ad919a067d04)
 
This change based on the following two points.
**System time sensitivity**

Timer scheduling is based on the absolute time of the operating system and is sensitive to the operating system's time. Once the operating system's time changes, Timer scheduling is no longer precise.
The scheduled Thread Pool Executor scheduling is based on relative time and is not affected by changes in operating system time.

**Are anomalies captured**

Timer does not capture exceptions thrown by Timer Tasks, and in addition, Timer is single threaded. Once a scheduling task encounters an exception, the entire thread will terminate and other tasks that need to be scheduled will no longer be executed.
The scheduled Thread Pool Executor implements scheduling functions based on a thread pool. After a task throws an exception, other tasks can still execute normally.


## Brief change log

Replace `Timer` with single thread scheduled executor for `BlobServer`


## Verifying this change

This change is already covered by existing tests, such as *(BlobCacheCleanupTest, BlobServerCleanupTest and so on)*.
